    Solving triangular linear equations on well-ordered series #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.HahnTriangular.surjective {Γ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [LinearOrder Γ] [Field k] (T : HahnSeries Γ k →+ HahnSeries Γ k) (φ : Γ ≃o Γ) (causal : ∀ (x y : HahnSeries Γ k) (g : Γ), (∀ b ≤ g, x.coeff b = y.coeff b) → ∀ b ≤ φ g, (T x).coeff b = (T y).coeff b) (diagonal : ∀ (g : Γ) (d : k), ∃ (a : k), (T ((HahnSeries.single g) a)).coeff (φ g) = d ∧ ∀ b < φ g, (T ((HahnSeries.single g) a)).coeff b = 0) :
    Function.Surjective ⇑T

    Let T shift lowest exponents by an order isomorphism. If it respects agreement through each cutoff and a monomial can realize any prescribed leading coefficient at the shifted exponent, then T is surjective on Hahn series.
